about_the_game:
Ghetto Zombies Demo is an explosive preview of what you can expect from the full game! In this version, you’ll get a taste of the core elements that make Ghetto Zombies so unique:

🖌️ Graffiti Core Loop: Leave your mark in the chaos! Use the graffiti system to transform environments and complete strategic objectives while battling hordes of zombies.

🧟‍♂️ Face the Undead: Encounter different types of zombies, each with unique abilities and characteristics that will challenge your strategy and reflexes.

🔓 Unlock Dumpsters and Collect Weapons: Throughout the levels, gather resources and open dumpsters packed with quirky and powerful weapons to boost your survival chances.

This demo is just the beginning of an intense and stylish journey! Try it out, sharpen your skills, and get ready for the full release.

Demo Highlights:

  • Explore an action-packed level full of graffiti.

  • Discover zombies with unique personalities and attacks.

  • Test out the wacky weapons already available in this build.

Add Ghetto Zombies to your wishlist and join our Discord to share your thoughts. We’re excited to hear your feedback!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-1115G4
  • Memory: 6 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 650
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatibilidade com DirectX 9.0c

short_description: Ghetto Zombies is a colorfull pixel art shooter where the ghetto are the last hope against the zombies. In this humorous apocalypse, graffiti the city and use your crazy guns to defeat fun freaky-zombies hordes!
